items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: seeing people like Cannonball Adderley, Eddie Harris, Les McCann, Rahsaan Roland Kirk. Getting all of that early is what inspired me to do it.

ctx.x: It’s great to hear you and your band talk about what you do and where it comes from. And I’ll start off with something really easy, like whatever possessed you to try to make a living in the jazz world?

That’s a good question. You know I think it was just being inspired very young, being exposed to the music by my father, who is a music enthusiast and had all kinds of music around the house. The first record I remember hearing live was Ahmad Jamal “Live at the Pershing” and of course with “Poinciana” and Miles Davis “Live in Europe.” But there were other things, you know Miriam Makeba, James Brown, he was a big Mario Lanza fan, so there was a whole array of music, and seeing music live when I was small in…
Did your father play an instrument?
